## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D1 (b, clinical components). This is audit backlog UX-03 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: Component only, in /__ui. Later used on /consult/:id and its sub-pages, /nurse/:id, the patient record and the desk record. Doctor, nurse, receptionist.
Findings and reviewers: F-02, F-19 · reviewers A-01, B-03, B-08, C-02. Part 1 of 3 of audit backlog UX-03 (part 2 is the layout footer and save status; part 3 puts them on the screens).
Rationale: Three patient headers exist and the allergy looks different in each: a red pill on the chart, plain text in the consultation. The most safety-relevant element needs one form before it is pinned anywhere, or the pin hard-codes the difference.
Proposed UX behaviour: One PatientBanner in packages/ui with three variants. full: the chart header as today (avatar, name, age and sex, MRN in the mono face, date of birth, life stage, allergy block, consent, care team where recorded). strip: one row at 1024 px and wider and two rows at most below, 56 px, with name, age and sex, MRN, date of birth, the allergy block in words, consent, and slots for token and room; it wraps and never clips or shows an ellipsis alone. desk: name, age and sex, masked MRN, date of birth and no clinical data at all. The allergy block has one look everywhere: recorded allergies as a solid danger block with an icon and the words (for example Allergy: Penicillin (rash)); with more than two, the first two in words and a count that opens the full list; Allergies not recorded as a warning block with its own words; No known allergies as neutral text with a tick. Unknown is never shown as none. The strip exposes a pinned option and un-pins itself at 400 % zoom. The gallery shows every variant with one, three and five allergies, a long name, Arabic right-to-left and 375 px.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/medvya-workspace-concept.html, doctor view, audit note 2; screenshots docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/screenshots/doctor-1440.png, doctor-1024.png, doctor-768.png and doctor-375.png (the 375 one shows the clipping this ticket must not repeat); blueprint sections 6, 7 and 10.
Components and tokens affected: New PatientBanner (packages/ui/src/components/ui/patient-banner.tsx). Uses the tone tokens (danger, warning, neutral) and the heading, mono and caption type tokens. The old primitive IdentityBanner stays until the screen ticket removes it.
Front end and back end split: Front end only. No API change: the component takes props the screens already have.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the D1a tickets for control defaults, type tokens and tone tokens. File ownership in wave D1b: this ticket owns patient-banner.tsx and its test and gallery section only.
Clinical sign-off: Required before merge: questions 3 (what the strip shows; how five allergies show) and 4 (one look for the allergy, for not recorded and for no known allergies) of docs/product-ux-audit/11-pilot-doctor-validation-plan.md. The agreement is written on the issue with a date.
Effort and regression risk: M · Low in this ticket (no screen uses it yet). The allergy wording and the unknown, none and not recorded distinction must not change: the component only presents what the screens pass in.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Using it on any screen (the screen ticket in wave D2). (2) Changing allergy rules, wording or data. (3) The queue button in the strip (the queue rail ticket).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given /__ui, when the PatientBanner section is opened, then full, strip and desk render from the same component and the desk variant contains no allergy, diagnosis, medicine or vitals text
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a patient with five recorded allergies and a long name, when the strip renders at 1440, 1024, 768 and 375 px, then the first two allergies are readable in words, a count opens the rest, nothing is cut off and no ellipsis stands alone
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the three allergy states, when each renders, then Allergies not recorded is a warning block with words, No known allergies is neutral text with a tick, and neither can be produced by passing an empty list
- [ ] **AC4.** Given the allergy block, when it is viewed in greyscale and read by a screen reader, then the word Allergy and the substance are present as text
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the gallery in English and Arabic, when axe runs on every variant, then there is no violation and the layout mirrors in right-to-left
- [ ] **AC6.** Given the strip with the pinned option at 400 % zoom, when the page scrolls, then the strip scrolls with the content
- [ ] **AC7.** Given this ticket's issue, when it is closed, then it holds the pilot doctor's dated agreement on the strip contents and the allergy look

## Test notes

- Vitest: the three allergy states, the two-plus-count rule, the desk variant holds no clinical text (this one is the safety test: it fails when clinical props are rendered in desk).
- Playwright on /__ui: widths 1440, 1024, 768, 375; en and ar; axe clean; no text clipped (scrollWidth equals clientWidth on each cell).

## Notes / open questions

- Regression risk: low.
- What a receptionist can see of clinical data must not grow: the desk variant is how the type system enforces that on the client; the server rule is unchanged.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
